## Problem

What happened, and what did you expect?

## Reproduction

1. Describe the starting state.
2. Describe the actions.
3. Describe the result.

Include a small synthetic example if possible. Do not attach private repositories, code, credentials or identifying paths.

## Environment

- GitVista commit/version:
- OS/version and CPU architecture:
- Git version (`git --version`):

## Evidence

Include exact sanitized error text and screenshots when relevant. For performance reports, say whether you used a release build and whether memory includes WebView/GPU/Networking processes. Distinguish a measured result from an estimate.

## Checks

- [ ] I searched existing issues.
- [ ] I removed private code, paths, credentials and personal information.
